snippet.title: Hounded - Demo Introduction Gameplay Reveal
snippet.description:
Wishlist Hounded on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3695350/Hounded/

Take a look at the gameplay reveal for the introduction section to our Hounded demo. 

Duke is following the scent of his Master through the sprawling forest until it leads him to the village of Tideswell,  now under control of the Royal army.
